svg.aria-label: Perfboard layout seen from the top: every part, link and jumper on a 16 by 22 hole board
svg.text: Perfboard layout, seen from the top (component side)
16 × 22 holes at 2.54 mm (40.6 × 55.9 mm), drawn to scale. Dashed outlines are parts underneath, with only their pins coming through.
Seen from above, the XIAO is face down, so its pin order is mirrored: D0 to D6 run up the left side, 5V to D7 up the right.
Bare wire or solder bridge, hole to hole. Black is ground, red is 3V3, other colors are signals.
Insulated jumper wire on the top side (two of them).
Pin or lead of a part underneath (XIAO, button 2, capacitor, Q1, Q2), coming up through the board.
Lead of a part on the top side.
Hole for a wire to the ring, the motor or the battery.
Pink dotted circles: where the ring sits above the board.
Everything on top is flat except button 1, so the ring can sit low. Rows 1 to 7 hold no parts.
